subject: literacy
concept: Using describing words (adjectives) to make writing more vivid and specific
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student adds describing-word tiles to a plain sentence and compares the before/after
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described picture to the sentence with matching descriptive words
exercise.abstract: Student revises a plain sentence by adding at least two describing words

misconception_flags: adds words that don't function as real descriptions (e.g. repeats the noun)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
